To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
business model innovations are the most powerful way of making companies more sustainable.

(a) the business models of most companies in our sample have not yet been transformed to become sustainable, but (b) a significant minority of companies in our sample has already transformed its business model to become more sustainable and (c) the business models that have been transformed to become more sustainable are more profitable than the average of the business models in our sample.

business model innovations can be classified into four categories: (i) business model innovations that are based on a new value proposition, (ii) business model innovations based on a new business model architecture, (iii) business model innovations with a new revenue model, and (iv) business model innovations in the form of new business models.
